name: Destina (Destination Sport)
verdict: Destina is Destination Sport, the sports travel division of The Portman Travel Group Limited, a private UK company that holds 75% or more of Destination Sport Limited. Portman's own PSC register states there is no registrable person or legal entity with significant control over it; no state body or fund appears in the chain. Nothing found.
note: Majesticks GC partner (livgolf.com/majesticks-gc, verified on the team page 2026-10-03; partner logo links to destinationsport.com).
